Hi Ben,

Thanks for the warm intro last week. We're excited to get set up as a vendor for Redwood. To get the PO and first payment routed, the accounts team asked me to send the Certificate of Insurance and a completed W-9.

I've attached our latest COI and W-9 (see attachment stubs below). Quick questions:
- Does Redwood require "additional insured" and a waiver of subrogation endorsement on the GL policy?
- Is there a minimum cyber liability limit you need to see?

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@galaxytech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GalaxyTech supplier setup: COI & PO

Alex — thanks for sending these over and for moving quickly. A few items from procurement before we can issue the PO: 

1) Insurance: Redwood requires Commercial General Liability naming "Redwood Inference, its officers, directors, employees and agents" as additional insured. We also need a waiver of subrogation on the GL policy. For cyber, our minimum expectation is $2M in cyber liability; if you have a lower limit, please flag it and we'll route for exception.

2) W-9: Received; procurement will confirm TIN matches.

3) Vendor packet: I'm attaching our vendor onboarding packet (PDF) — it lists required docs and the PO timing. Once COI + W-9 are accepted, procurement issues a conditional PO (net 30) and we'll link a DocuSign signature request for the standard vendor terms.

4) Upload: You can upload to our secure vendor portal here: https://vendor.redwood.com/upload (or reply and I'll initiate DocuSign).

Can you send an updated COI showing the additional insured and waiver, or confirm that your broker can issue an endorsement?

Thanks — looping Marissa (procurement) to confirm the PO cadence.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

Attachments: [redwood_vendor_onboarding_packet.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 11:21:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: GalaxyTech supplier setup: COI & PO

Ben — forwarding my notes for the record before you push back to Alex.

On vendor insurance: please request the following explicitly from GalaxyTech's broker:
- Additional insured endorsement (CG 2010 or equivalent) naming "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents"
- Waiver of subrogation endorsement on GL
- Cyber liability: minimum $2,000,000. If they only carry $1M, we need to escalate and get a business justification from Sales; also request a copy of their most recent cyber controls summary (SOC/ISO or attestation)
- Effective dates must cover the initial contract term; if COI expires within 30 days, require an automatic renewal notice or updated COI prior to expiration.

PO workflow note: procurement will issue a conditional PO that says "PO subject to receipt of acceptable COI and W-9." Once we receive endorsement and validate TIN, we'll flip to an active PO and route DocuSign for acceptance. Typical timing: 3–5 business days after acceptable insurance is on file.

I'll add a HubSpot note and attach the checklist (I've already created DEAL-8271). If they push back on cyber limits, let me know and I'll approve an exception path if the commercial case supports it.

Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0144

If Redwood can accept $1M with a compensating control (we can provide a recent third-party security attestation and our vulnerability remediation cadence), we'd appreciate an exception.

Attachments: [GalaxyTech_COI_v2.pdf (application/pdf)], [GalaxyTech_W9.pdf (application/pdf)], [GalaxyTech_Security_Attestation.pdf (application/pdf)]

Portal upload completed — here's the HubSpot/portal reference for the file: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8271/files/galaxytech-coi-v2

If procurement can issue the conditional PO with the note about "cyber limit pending exception review," we can proceed with onboarding and start provisioning. Also please send the DocuSign link for the PO when it's ready (the finance team is standing by).

Appreciate your help — happy to set a 15-min call if needed.

Best,
Alex
